income_forms.fit: Your natural loop is spot, price, commit, hold. Direct Wealth runs through nearly every branch of the chart, and Indirect Wealth stands openly at both ends — the year stem Bing and hour stem Bing flanking a Ren day master. That is a scanner trained on tangible positions: an asset, a batch, a holding you can inspect and value yourself. You tolerate gaps between gains because the accumulating base keeps thickening underneath. A closed sale or a repriced holding feeds your calibration directly; you do not need applause, you need the ledger to move.
income_forms.friction: The chart carries zero Output — wood counts nothing among the visible characters — so you produce no research note, no write-up, no thesis others can challenge. Your judgment stays private and uncorrected, which is fine when right and expensive when wrong. And with no Companion presence, you have no peer to co-sign a decision before you commit whole, which is your documented pattern.
income_forms.evidence: Indirect Wealth is heaviest after Direct Wealth — Bing flanks the chart at year and hour. Direct Wealth is heaviest of all: month stem Ding plus Direct Wealth hidden in the year branch Wu, hour branch Wu, and day branch Xu. Wood, the Output family, is absent, and Companion and Rob Wealth both count zero. The strength label reads 'follower-type features', meaning the day master leans into the wealth flow rather than fighting it.

income_forms.fit: Project work matches your deal-cycle rhythm: clear start, clear close, money collected within weeks. You enter, take a position, deliver, exit, rest. The life structure already prescribes this unit — spot, commit, hold, close, gap. Each finished project resets your scanner, and the collected receivable is exactly the short monetary feedback your system learns from. Indirect Wealth at both chart ends keeps the hunt alive across decades; the luck pillars from age 23 through 43 run through wood and fire territory (Jia Wu, Gui Si), feeding both scanning and holding.
income_forms.friction: Projects with vague scopes, endless revisions, or 'impact measured in two years' starve you — the feedback cycle is too long for the ledger-based calibration built into a Direct-Wealth-saturated chart. Also avoid projects where you must delegate the books to juniors with no co-signing rule; with no Companion energy, you cannot internally supervise a team, only an external prop can.
income_forms.evidence: Direct Wealth appears in three of four branches — Wu, Wu, and inside Xu — making the short monetary feedback loop structural, not preference. Luck pillars from age 23 to 43 (Jia Wu, Gui Si, Ren Chen) carry the fire and resource tones that support both holding and external backing.

income_forms.fit: Equity suits the holding instinct: you buy into or earn a stake in something tangible and let Direct Wealth's compounding habit work. This is not trading — it is taking a position in a business, a property vehicle, or a venture where you hold paper and watch the book. Your reluctance to spend on display frees cash for stakes, and the day branch Xu carries Seven Killings and Direct Resource hidden together — pressure absorbed by structure — which reads as tolerating the stress of ownership if rules exist.
income_forms.friction: Equity is illiquid, and your system needs closed numbers to calibrate. A stake that reports nothing for years gives your spot-and-commit loop nothing to learn from. Also, minority stakes in informal arrangements with zero backing are precisely the structure to avoid — no platform, no co-signing rule, no institution carrying part of the load.
income_forms.evidence: Direct Wealth hides inside the day branch Xu alongside Direct Resource, and Seven Killings holds a small presence there — pressure present but bounded. Direct Resource also hides in the month branch You, the one backing layer available, so equity works only where that institutional prop exists.

income_forms.fit: Consulting monetizes your pricing instinct: people pay you to tell them what something is worth and who owns it. The scanner that asks 'who owns the resource, what does it cost' within a day is exactly what a buyer or seller hires. Short engagements with defined deliverables fit the deal-cycle rhythm, and billing per engagement keeps the feedback monetary.
income_forms.friction: Consulting is selling judgment, and judgment sold requires explanation — but Output counts zero in this chart. Writing proposals, teaching reasoning, justifying methodology in front of rooms drains you faster than the work itself pays. You will win on the first meeting and lose the deal at the report stage unless someone else packages your call.
income_forms.evidence: The Output family — Eating God and Hurting Officer — both count zero among the ten gods, while Direct and Indirect Wealth together dominate. The chart takes positions; it does not narrate them. Metal, which carries the Resource layer, counts only one, so the reflective, explanatory channel is thin.

income_forms.fit: Content ranks low but not zero, because one narrow format works: the ledger made public. A plain record of positions taken, prices paid, outcomes closed — not opinion, not narrative. That format needs no creative Output energy, just the bookkeeping habit you already run daily. If someone else edits and packages, the format can carry your reputation to people who might later bring you deals, feeding the Indirect Wealth scanner indirectly.
income_forms.friction: Any format requiring sustained invention — storytelling, opinion, entertainment — collides with the total absence of wood in the chart. You will publish twice and stop. Content also pays on a long feedback cycle, which the Direct-Wealth calibration cannot learn from; months of unmeasured audience growth starve the loop that keeps you engaged.
income_forms.evidence: Wood counts zero among the five elements, so the producing-and-expressing family is absent. Fire dominates at five of eight visible characters — wealth energy everywhere, expression energy nowhere. Direct Wealth's need for short monetary confirmation conflicts with content's slow compounding.

income_forms.fit: Salary is not useless here — it is the thick steady base the life structure explicitly prescribes, the layer that carries gap years between deals. A fixed income protects the unsupported day master, whose strength label reads follower-type: the chart leans on external structure rather than generating its own. As a floor, salary works.
income_forms.friction: As the only income, a flat salary starves the flanking Indirect Wealth stems — the scanner withers when there is no position to take, no resource to price. You will become the employee who quietly resells company surplus, negotiates the vendor contract on the side, and feels dead by year three. The month branch You holds Direct Resource: rules and institutions suit you, but only as backing, not as ceiling.
income_forms.evidence: Direct Resource hides in the month branch You, giving one institutional anchor. The day master's strength label 'follower-type features' means the chart runs on external structure. Indirect Wealth at both year and hour stems needs positional expression or it turns into restlessness.

leaks.how_it_shows: With Companion counting zero, you have no internal model of a peer's incentives. You meet someone with a resource, commit whole — your documented pattern of dropping side interests and putting yourself fully behind a deal — and discover later the partner kept a different ledger. The failure mode is not conflict; it is that no one ever wrote down who owns what, because you skipped that phase when you moved fast.
leaks.rule: If a deal involves anyone besides you, then before money moves, write one page naming ownership shares, exit terms, and who signs — and if the partner refuses the page, the deal is off regardless of how good it looks.

leaks.how_it_shows: Fire fills five of the eight visible characters — the wealth flow is torrential relative to a lone water day master. Your spot-and-commit speed means you can be fully positioned before you have checked what the position costs you if it runs against you. The chart commits whole; nothing in it hedges by instinct. One large position taken at full size is the structural leak, not recklessness in general.
leaks.rule: If a single opportunity would use more than a fixed fraction of your deployable funds — set the fraction now, in writing, while calm — then split the entry into two stages at least a month apart, and if stage one loses, stage two is cancelled automatically.

leaks.how_it_shows: You avoid display spending — that habit holds. The leak is different: because Output is absent, you deflect social requests with money instead of words. A relative asks for a loan, a friend proposes a joint purchase, and rather than negotiate terms aloud — narration drains you — you pay to end the conversation. The money leaves quietly and no ledger line ever names it.
leaks.rule: If someone asks you for money and you feel the urge to just pay and move on, then impose a 48-hour delay and require yourself to say one spoken sentence of terms — amount, repayment, or gift — before any transfer happens.

conservative.design: Anchor everything in the base: a salaried or recurring-income role inside an institution with real rules, plus small self-managed holdings you can inspect and value yourself. No informal partnerships, no co-owned ventures without paper. Let the Direct Wealth habit — steady saving, careful books, no display spending — do the compounding while the scanner idles at low intensity, taking only one small, fully-collateralized position per year.
conservative.preconditions: Choose this when your current income is the only floor under the household, when you have no partner or platform that can co-sign decisions, or when the day master feels thin — the chart's follower-type label means leaning on institutional structure is legitimate support, not weakness. Also appropriate if a past deal loss is still unabsorbed.
conservative.evidence: Direct Resource hides in the month branch You and inside the day branch Xu — two anchors of institutional backing. Direct Wealth in three branches makes slow compounding structural. Fire at five of eight characters means the wealth flow never fully stops, so even the conservative path keeps one positional outlet to prevent restless missteps.

balanced.design: Run the hybrid the life structure prescribes: roughly a thick steady base — recurring income from a role, a managed book, or holdings — plus spaced lumpy moves, one genuine opportunity taken whole rather than ten half-held. Work in deal-cycles: spot, commit, hold, close, then a scheduled gap that produces nothing. Each position needs one external prop: a co-signing partner, a custodial platform, a written contract — Direct Resource doing externally what the chart cannot do internally.
balanced.preconditions: Requires that you already have the base layer running and at least one trustworthy co-signer for decisions — a person or an institution. Requires written deal terms as a standing habit. This matches the luck pillar sequence from age 33 onward (Gui Si, Ren Chen), where resource and water tones return to support the day master's holding capacity.
balanced.evidence: Direct Wealth heaviest overall with Indirect Wealth flanking at year and hour stems defines the base-plus-deals shape. Companion counting zero mandates exactly one external co-signer per venture. The Ren Chen pillar from age 43 adds water to the day master's side, extending holding endurance.

aggressive.design: Weight the mix toward Indirect Wealth: concentrate on fewer, larger tangible positions — assets you can inspect, price, and hold outright — funded by a deliberately kept-thin base. You run alone with full ledger control, taking one whole position at a time and closing it before scanning again. The single external prop is non-negotiable: one written rule set and one co-signing person, because the chart has no internal check on commit-whole momentum.
aggressive.preconditions: Only viable when the base layer already covers living costs for an extended period, when you have absorbed at least one full loss without destabilizing the household, and when the current luck pillar carries wealth-supporting tones — the Jia Wu stretch from age 23, or fire-heavy years. Not viable while any debt is outstanding or while no co-signer exists.
aggressive.evidence: Indirect Wealth stands at both flanks — year stem Bing and hour stem Bing — an open scanner from early decades onward. Seven Killings holds a small bounded presence in the day branch Xu, giving just enough pressure tolerance for concentrated positions. Fire's dominance at five of eight characters supplies the fuel; the lone water day master sets the hard limit on size.

asset_ideas.idea: A micro acquisitions book: buy small income-producing assets — a closed shop's inventory, a piece of equipment on discount, a small rentable space — refurbish minimally, then resell or rent it out under a written contract.
asset_ideas.uses_talent: This is your documented behavior one step formalized: a friend mentions a shop closing and within a day you have priced it, contacted the owner, and made an offer. Direct Wealth in three branches means the rental or resale income feeds the compounding base, while each purchase exercises the Indirect Wealth scanner at the flanks.
asset_ideas.fits_life_structure: It runs on deal-cycles with clear starts and closes, keeps the ledger entirely in your hands, and each rental contract supplies the one external prop — an institutional rule set carrying part of the load. Feedback is monetary and fast: a collected rent or a closed sale within weeks.
asset_ideas.startup_cost: Moderate — the price of one modest asset plus a standard written contract template; your savings can seed the first purchase without borrowing.
asset_ideas.likely_blocker: The gap between purchase and first collected income. With zero Output energy, you will not market the asset — it sits vacant while you scan the next deal. Pre-arrange the resale or rental channel before buying, or the position turns into dead stock.

asset_ideas.idea: A paid pricing-and-sourcing desk: businesses and individuals pay you a fixed fee to find, price, and negotiate the acquisition of a specific tangible thing — equipment, stock, a premises — which you then hand over, taking no stake.
asset_ideas.uses_talent: It monetizes the exact question you already ask first — who owns it, what does it cost, can I take a position — without requiring you to hold anything. Indirect Wealth at year and hour stems runs the hunt; the engagement closes in weeks, feeding the short monetary feedback cycle the Direct Wealth layer calibrates on.
asset_ideas.fits_life_structure: Consulting-shaped but deal-cycled: one client, one target, one closing, then a genuine gap. The client's own budget and contract is the external prop that carries risk you would otherwise hold alone. No team needed — Companion absence is irrelevant when the work is single-handed by design.
asset_ideas.startup_cost: Low — a one-page service description, a fee schedule, and referrals from the first two clients; your existing network of contacts with spare capacity is the inventory.
asset_ideas.likely_blocker: Explaining your value. With Output counting zero, you will not write the pitch or narrate your method. Get one client by direct demonstration — find them something at a price they could not — and let the closed number speak; do not build a website first.

asset_ideas.idea: A co-managed holdings vehicle with one trusted partner: a simple written arrangement where you select and price tangible holdings and the partner co-signs every entry and exit, with shares and exit terms fixed on paper before the first purchase.
asset_ideas.uses_talent: Your whole-commit instinct stays intact — you still spot and commit — but the co-signing rule supplies the missing check that Companion absence removes. Direct Wealth's compounding habit manages the book between deals; your reluctance toward display spending keeps capital inside the vehicle.
asset_ideas.fits_life_structure: The life structure explicitly requires exactly one external prop per venture and warns against full solo informal arrangements — this design is that prescription made concrete. The shared ledger forces the written terms your fast-moving pattern would otherwise skip.
asset_ideas.startup_cost: Moderate — joint capital, a lawyer-drafted agreement once, and the discipline of a fixed monthly review meeting you cannot cancel.
asset_ideas.likely_blocker: Choosing the partner under time pressure. Your pattern is committing whole within a day; applied to partner selection, that is the leak this vehicle exists to stop. If no candidate will sign a written agreement without hesitation, run the vehicle as a solo book with an external accountant as the check instead.
